known_as.all: Tap all {n} ancient figures best known as a {value}.

rows.label: Aristotle
rows.hook: tutored a famous young conqueror and wrote on logic, ethics and biology

rows.label: Marcus Aurelius
rows.description: 16th Roman Emperor from 161 to 180 and Stoic philosopher
rows.hook: ruled an empire while keeping a private journal of Stoic reflections called Meditations

rows.label: Socrates
rows.hook: was sentenced to drink hemlock after relentlessly questioning his fellow Athenians

rows.label: Confucius
rows.hook: inspired a school of thought built on family duty and respect, with sayings gathered by students

rows.label: Virgil
rows.hook: wrote the Aeneid, an epic about a Trojan refugee whose descendants found a great city

rows.label: Herodotus
rows.hook: was nicknamed the Father of History for chronicling the wars between Greeks and Persians

rows.label: Ovid
rows.hook: wrote the Metamorphoses, a long work retelling myths of transformation, and was exiled by Augustus

rows.label: Thucydides
rows.hook: chronicled the long war between Athens and Sparta, in which he served as a commander

rows.label: Sappho
rows.description: ancient Greek poet from Lesbos (c. 630-c. 570 BC)
rows.hook: wrote passionate lyric verse that survives mostly in fragments and was called the Tenth Muse

rows.label: Laozi
rows.description: 6th-century BC semi-legendary Chinese philosopher, founder of Taoism
rows.hook: is credited with the Tao Te Ching, the founding text of Taoism

rows.label: Aeschylus
rows.hook: is called the father of tragedy and wrote the Oresteia trilogy

rows.label: Euclid
rows.hook: wrote the Elements, a geometry textbook used for over two thousand years

rows.label: Epicurus
rows.hook: taught that calm and freedom from pain are the path to the highest good

rows.label: Hesiod
rows.description: ancient Greek poet of the archaic period

rows.label: Plotinus
rows.description: Hellenistic Platonist philosopher and founder of Neoplatonism (c. 204/5–270)

rows.label: Catullus
rows.description: lyric Latin poet of the Roman Republic
